title: Charging Memory Care Add-Ons and One-to-One Companion Hours
content:
Add-ons under the Memory Care Residency Agreement follow the tier billed: whichever tier the residency is billed at in the period decides which add-ons apply and at what price.

## Charging rules

1. **Monthly care add-ons.** The incontinence supplies fee is charged monthly where the tier does not include incontinence supplies. The insulin administration fee, the behavioral support plan fee and the two-person assist fee are charged monthly where the care plan requires them and the tier's fee is not 0.00.
2. **One-to-one companion care.** One-to-one companion care is booked in shifts of at least the tier's minimum hours per shift (4 hours on every tier), which is also the minimum billed per scheduled shift. Hours within the tier's included hours for the calendar month are posted at 0.00, and further hours at the one-to-one companion hourly rate (32.50 on every tier). The hours already used in a calendar month are all one-to-one companion hours charged on the residency for that month, including hours posted at 0.00 as included.
3. **Other charges.** Escorts to outside medical appointments are charged at the escort hourly fee with the escort minimum hours as a minimum; guest meals at the guest meal fee; the insurer administration fee monthly while a long-term care insurer is billed directly; the suite change fee once per family-requested suite change; and the returned payment fee once per returned payment.
4. **Never charged.** Medication management and hospice coordination are never charged where the tier includes them.
5. **When add-ons may be posted.** Add-on charges may be posted only while the residency is in active, on leave or notice given status, as shown on the residency record.

## Monthly care add-on: when it is charged

| The care plan requires the service | The tier's fee for it | Monthly charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Above 0.00 | Charged at the tier's fee |
| Yes | 0.00 (included) | None |
| No | Any | None |

This table covers insulin administration, the behavioral support plan and two-person assist. Incontinence supplies follow the tier alone: charged monthly where the tier does not include them.

## Included one-to-one hours by tier

| Tier | Included hours per calendar month |
|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 0 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 0 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 0 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 0 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 4 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 8 |

## One-to-one hours: worked figures (hypothetical bookings)

- **Deluxe suite, advanced program.** 4 hours have already been charged this month (at 0.00). A 6-hour shift follows: 4 more hours fall within the 8 included hours and are posted at 0.00; the remaining 2 hours are charged at 32.50 each, 65.00.
- **Private suite, advanced program.** The first 4-hour shift of the month uses the 4 included hours and is posted at 0.00; a second 4-hour shift in the same month is charged 4 hours at 32.50, 130.00.
- **Private suite, enhanced program.** No hours are included; a 4-hour shift is charged 130.00.
- **A new calendar month** starts the count of hours used again from zero.

## Posting status

| Residency status | Add-on charge may be posted |
|---|---|
| Active, on leave or notice given | Yes |
| Pending admission, vacated, closed or cancelled | No |

The second row follows from the closed list in rule 5.
